title: Webb's first images
event_title: The first image from the James Webb Space Telescope is released
lede: The first full-colour images from the James Webb Space Telescope, followed from the objects people looked up to what they borrowed.
description: A time-ordered ripple map for Webb's first images: each step dated and marked by how it was measured.
limits: Wikipedia stands in for all attention and one city's library for borrowing. Timing shows order, not proof that the event caused each step on its own.
dataline: Wikimedia pageviews (daily), Seattle Public Library checkouts (monthly)

steps.title: People look up what the pictures show
